purpose: Full-viewport (100vh) closing block: eyebrow, H2, lede, an isometric layer-stack illustration whose layers drop and seat, and a single solid pill overlapping the art. Progress p is driven by useInView (NOT scroll position): 0->1 over 2.4s when >=45% in view, back to 0 over 0.9s when it leaves. When seated (p >= 0.92) a flash, three rings and diagonal sweeps fire.

budgetBasis.rule: maxWords = clone word count + max(1, ceil(25%)). cloneChars is the clone's own character count; originalChars (where present) is the measured character count of the live original's text role (length only, no copy).
budgetBasis.wordCount: whitespace tokens containing at least one alphanumeric character

fixedInternals.item: Illustration geometry (four slabs at cy 451/411/361/252, chip cy 158, dashed lines at x 147/227/347/427), mask and flash gradient
The stage is 100vh tall (inner box height 100vh, padding 80 24 10)

motion.triggerNotes: Progress value p animates 0->1 (2.4s easeInOut) when >=45% in view and returns to 0 (0.9s easeOut) when out. Dashed lines march while any part is in view. This is an IntersectionObserver trigger, not scroll-linked.
motion.loopPeriodNote: Diagonal sweeps repeat forever after seating: 2.1s duration + 3.4s repeatDelay = 5.5s (derived from the code constants).
motion.reducedMotionDetail: p is jumped to 1 and seated is true; layer springs are bypassed (raw transforms); flash, rings, sweeps and dash march are off.

responsive.change: .l9cc-stage switches from height-driven (min(100%, 66vh), aspect 572/687) to width-driven (100% wide, max 420px, height auto) so the art fits a phone viewport.

notes: The illustration is an ORIGINAL drawing; the original's SVG artwork is not reproduced in this repo.
